cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. These eighty wedding place cards need names. Your bin labels have better lettering than our invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. I'd read the names. You'd only do the beautiful part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your aunt will complain if I use purple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle my aunt. The ink colour could be entirely yours.

mechanism: A modestly casts itself as the name-reader while setting artistic freedom and handling family objections so B volunteers for tedious place cards.
confusable: Not an overt assignment or empty flattery: A quietly decides the terms that make the unwanted work attractive enough for B to choose it.
comparison: Creative control over lettering versus protected storage territory.
